listed_quote.quote: has closed, creating a publicly registered non-traded business development company

announcement.quote: The proposal to permit increased leverage (Proposal 4) must be approved by TPIC’s stockholders for the Merger to occur.

outcome_evidence.quote: the merger between Triton Pacific Investment Corporation, Inc. (“TPIC”) and Pathway Capital Opportunity Fund, Inc. (“PWAY”) has closed

deals.notes: Merger was completed (closed 2019-04-01; TPIC renamed TP Flexible Income Fund) but the funds are described as non-traded, so not a listed pair. Shareholders of both approved on 2019-03-15 (8-K filed 2019-03-20). Direction (TPIC as survivor/acquirer) inferred from TPIC being the registrant on the N-14 and being renamed FLEX; the text says 'merger between TPIC and PWAY to create TP Flexible Income Fund'. The listed_quote shows the combined fund is non-traded; no text shown says PWAY itself is non-traded.
